scope: Documented software capabilities and validation requirements; not a validated calculator configuration or enzyme accuracy benchmark.
purpose: Targeted chemical-step energetics after structural assessment; separate from cofolding, conformational sampling and de novo design.

uma.nitro_is: An optimized inference mode, not a separate checkpoint or an electrostatic-embedding scheme.
uma.nitro_scope: Eligible small UMA checkpoints, supported NVIDIA Ampere/Hopper/Blackwell devices, single-system/single-worker energy and force evaluation. Verify the actual runtime mode; documented fallback is possible.

precision_policy.screening_or_relaxation_candidate: tf32, optionally Nitro; benchmark energies/forces and record actual settings
precision_policy.final_r_ts_p_energies: Recompute all reported state energies using the same checkpoint, task, embedding and explicit final precision
precision_policy.hessian_and_frequencies: Prefer explicit IEEE FP32; compare FP64 where supported and needed. Direct Hessian requests do not run in Nitro. Finite differences may use force evaluations, but step-size and force precision must be checked.
precision_policy.do_not: Assume the named default preserves precision across fairchem releases, or claim Nitro acceleration when a fallback ran. Float64 Hessian assembly does not restore information lost in lower-precision forces.

uma.level_of_theory: The D4rev fine-tune differs from the base molecular model. Do not mix checkpoints or add a second dispersion correction to the dispersion-inclusive fine-tune.

embedding_options.meaning: Vacuum ML-region potential plus classical environment coupling; total charge/spin inputs do not establish response to an external MM field.

embedding_options.documented_support: Opt-in embedcharge in the reviewed newer toolkit
embedding_options.meaning: xTB embedded-minus-vacuum correction on the ML region plus link hydrogens, with ONIOM-EE Coulomb subtraction and consistent derivatives.
embedding_options.validation: Older local embedcharge code was flagged unsafe. Do not enable that implementation based on newer documentation. Verify the actual revision, boundary/link mapping, fixed point-charge set and absence of double counting before use.

embedding_options.documented_support: Newer toolkit DFT/MM backend with embedcharge
embedding_options.meaning: MM point charges enter the PySCF electronic Hamiltonian; distinct from an MLIP plus xTB correction.
embedding_options.validation: Verify the selected DFT backend, Hamiltonian, force derivatives and boundary treatment. This is not Nitro inference.

embedding_options.documented_support: Separate EMLE engine offers electrostatic, mechanical and nonpolarizable modes
embedding_options.meaning: Explicit electrostatic ML embedding, including polarization-aware options.
embedding_options.validation: Compatibility with this local toolkit, the selected vacuum potential, elements/charges and metal chemistry remains unverified. No integration or scientific accuracy is asserted.

benchmark_before_adoption: Identical coordinates, charge and spin: compare energy differences and forces between old/reference and proposed fast settings, including repeated calls and changed structures.
Check finite-difference force/energy consistency, Hessian symmetry and step-size convergence, negative-mode identity and IRC connectivity.
Use the same embedding/reference and numerical settings for every reported state; test boundary, point-charge and ML-region sensitivity.
Compare a small set of characterized mechanisms against independent reference calculations and experimental trends; benchmark speed separately.
verified_in_this_work: Documentation/source inspection and offline gate tests only. No engine environment upgrade, checkpoint download, GPU benchmark or scientific barrier validation.
